title: Video downloader
description: Saves a YouTube, X or Twitch video or its audio to Downloads, through yt-dlp and ffmpeg from Homebrew. Paste a link on its page and pick a format; its menu-bar item shows a download's progress, and a click there saves the copied link.
examples: Copy a YouTube link, open Video downloader, Return: the video saves to ~/Downloads
On its page, paste a link and click a format: the progress shows there, then Reveal in Finder
